requirements.Standard: Globally unique branch/module/node IDs; aliases allowed but IDs persist.
Explicit deletion reason: what recurring capability fails if removed?
Every prerequisite is explicit and resolves to a node/interface; no hidden cycles.
One or more observable things a competent learner can do, not merely topics covered.
Small set of load-bearing concepts and models; distinguish required from enrichment.
At minimum: rigorous spine; primary/original source where meaningful; counterpoint/rival; case/data/artifact; reference.
Where relevant, test claims outside the culture/period that generated the dominant textbook account.
Specify which formation modes R/S/P/M/D/A/B/C/F/T/V/L are required.
State what must be learned unaided, where AI may tutor/collaborate/delegate, and what provenance/evals are required.
Unseen transfer + failure/boundary + check + defense; delayed retest for foundational nodes.
Where meaningful, link to measurement, field observation, operations, primary documents, users, physical artifacts, or real decisions.
Include strong, weak, and misleading examples; require comparison, not only production.
Identify hazards, vulnerable stakeholders, legal/professional constraints, and stop rules appropriate to domain.
Provide multiple ways to access ideas where possible while preserving the actual mastery target.
Define external prompts/cases that can stress the node without leaking into normal teaching.
Record sources, evidence maturity, known gaps, dissent, version, and reason for curriculum changes.
